name: brainpet
description: A persistent virtual pet driven by its own LLM. Talk to it on chat.input (mention its name, or use one of the quick verbs feed / play / cuddle / clean / sleep / wake) and the pet's LLM reacts in character + decides what its stats do. Stats (hunger, happiness, energy, cleanliness, bond) decay between interactions; the node schedules its next autonomous tick dynamically based on the stat closest to crossing a threshold. Death is real — if the pet starves it goes to the cemetery (`brainpet.cemetery`) with a LLM-generated epitaph. Drive everything via natural chat or via `brainpet.command` with JSON `{action, ...}` — accepted actions: talk {text}, feed [food], play, cuddle, clean, sleep, wake, rename {name}, kill, revive, status.

default_subscriptions.description: Two ways to interact: (1) mention the pet's name anywhere in your message → the pet's LLM replies in character + applies stat effects; (2) single-word verb (feed / play / pet / cuddle / clean / sleep / wake) → immediate care action.
Pet control plane. Publish JSON `{action, ...}` or a loose string. Accepted actions: talk {text}, feed [food], play, cuddle, clean, sleep, wake, rename {name}, kill, revive, status.
